festival.title: The Festival
festival.description: Sticks n’ Festival is an AI creative festival organized by SOUTS (Side Out Sticks). We showcase emerging storytelling formats powered by artificial intelligence on the big screen and beyond.
festival.description2: We believe artificial intelligence does not replace human creativity, it expands it. Sticks n’ Festival exists to support the creators building the next generation of narrative experiences.
festival.description3: If you are exploring what storytelling means in this new era, this space is for you.

venue.title: Venue

bios.alvaroBrechner: Award-winning director and screenwriter ('A Twelve-Year Night', 'Mr. Kaplan'). His films have premiered at Cannes and Venice, representing Uruguay at the Oscars multiple times.
bios.fedeAlvarez: Hollywood director known for 'Alien: Romulus', 'Don't Breathe', and 'Evil Dead'. He burst onto the scene with the viral short 'Panic Attack!' featuring giant robots invading Montevideo.
bios.luisaPereira: Artist, engineer, and musician based in NYC. Professor at NYU ITP/IMA. Her interactive installations and generative machines explore the intersection of music and code.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Creators, artists, filmmakers, technologists, storytellers, and creative teams based in Latin America developing projects that incorporate AI into their creative process.
faq.a2: Films where AI tools (generative video, voice, script) play a significant role in the creative process.
faq.q3: Can I submit if I'm not from Latam?
faq.a3: For this first edition, we are focusing exclusively on projects from Latin American creators to highlight regional talent.
faq.q4: Do I need to attend the festival in person?
faq.a4: No. While we encourage creators to join us in Montevideo, physical attendance is not required. Selected works will be screened regardless, and we'll coordinate online participation when possible.
faq.a5: We will announce prize details closer to the festival. Awards include Best International AI Film, Best Uruguayan AI Film, and Pitch Competition winners.
faq.q6: What percentage of my film needs to be AI-generated?
faq.a6: There's no strict percentage, but AI must play a significant creative role (not just color grading or upscaling). If AI shaped your visuals, narrative, audio, or performance, you're eligible.
faq.a7: All AI tools are welcome: Runway, Midjourney, Sora, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, open source models, custom models, etc. We value innovation and artistic vision over specific platforms.
faq.q8: Do I keep the rights to my work?
faq.a8: Yes, 100%. You retain all intellectual property and distribution rights. We only request festival screening rights for promotional purposes.
faq.a9: Yes! Submit as many works as you like across different categories. Each submission will be reviewed independently.
